title: The foundation for teams who ship
body: Six promises — every one enforced in CI so they stay true across every release.

fast.title: Fast
fast.body: Tuned for first-paint — prefetched routes, CLS-safe fonts, tight bundles.

powerful.title: Powerful
powerful.body: Every layer is editable. No vendor lock-in on fonts, colors, content, or routes.

security.title: Secure
security.body: CSP, safe headers, validated inputs at every boundary. Shipped locked down.

custom.title: Customizable
custom.body: Rebrand, relocalize, reshape from the config folder — no component rewrites.

control.title: Full control
control.body: Drop below the surface when defaults don't fit. No rewrites, no forks.

ai.title: AI-friendly
ai.body: Typed routes + typed translations let LLM copilots do the tedious work safely.
